task: Add a per-membership is_default flag to user_projects with a role-gated set/clear API, a DB partial-unique-index invariant, and updates to the two existing project-list read models.

key_reasoning.reason: 4 distinct components across 3 layers: the UserProject DB model (new is_default column), ProjectAssignmentService (new set/clear-default transactional logic plus reuse of the existing _reject_if_personal_project guard), 2 new API endpoints (PUT/DELETE .../default), and two separate read models (ProjectInfo and AdminUserProject) that both need the field — flagged in technical-analysis.md as easy to update one and miss the other.

Base M for the transactional swap-and-idempotency logic (unset old default, set new, with 404/no-op semantics) which has no single exact precedent, even though the partial-unique-index pattern (Budget model) and the is_project_admin column pattern both exist to clone. Bumped to L by the authorization red flag: the new endpoints must gate on platform-level admin/maintainer role, and technical-analysis.md explicitly calls out the is_project_admin / is_default same-row collision risk as 'the case most likely to be implemented wrong.'

3 layers touched — API (2 new endpoints), Service (ProjectAssignmentService), and DB/Persistence (additive column plus a new partial-unique-index migration). A schema migration is required, which per calibration guidance puts Affected Layers at L even though the migration itself is additive-only with no backfill.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: affects authentication/authorization — set/clear-default endpoints require a platform-level admin/maintainer permission check, with an explicit risk of confusing it with the is_project_admin flag living on the same row.
